actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} two attacks, using [[/item .mmScratch0000000]]{Scratch} or [[/item .Spw5gbTlI2AKsGWd]]{Longbow} in any combination. It can replace one attack with a [[/item .mmBite0000000000]]{Bite} attack.

actions.name: bite (tiger or hybrid form only)
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=jgkWL5fxyqrDPr4D]]. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmWeretiger00000]{Weretiger} under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s' curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: shape-shift
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} shape-shifts into a Large tiger-humanoid hybrid form or a Large tiger, or it returns to its true humanoid form, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: prowl (tiger or hybrid form only)
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Speed without provoking &Reference[OpportunityAttacks]. At the end of this movement, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can take the &Reference[Hide apply=false] action.
